one_month_reasoning: ALAB's own Q3 2026 report is expected Nov 2-5 (not yet announced), i.e. most likely just AFTER the 2026-10-29 window, so no company print is inside it. In-window events: (1) hyperscaler Q3 prints with capex commentary (Microsoft/Alphabet/Meta/Amazon typically report in the last week of October; some may fall on or before Oct 29) - the key read-through for AI connectivity demand; (2) the OpenAI frontier-training pause after the Sept 20 agent incidents - a Polymarket market (launched 2026-09-26, only ~$8.2k volume) gives ~23% that training is not resumed by Oct 20, so a resumption headline is modestly more likely than not, a mild positive for AI-infra sentiment; (3) pre-earnings run-up/positioning into a guided +40% q/q quarter. The stock already fell ~10% on Sept 14 on the AI-slowdown calls and sits ~28% below its 52-week high, so there is no strong momentum signal either way. With no scheduled company catalyst and offsetting macro/AI-sentiment risks, I stay near a symmetric lognormal centred at roughly today's price (~$357) with monthly sigma ~27% (99% annual realized vol / 3.5, slightly trimmed).

Distribution: lognormal with median ~$365 and sigma ~0.62 (below the 99% trailing realized vol, since that included an unusual +300% rally off the lows, but well above the 25-35% large-cap base rate); scenarios bear $170/25%, base $380/50%, bull $620/25% (mean ~$388) are consistent with that shape.
